species: Three-month-old male Sprague-Dawley rats (weighing approximately 300 g) were purchased from the Hunan SLAC Laboratory Animal Center (Changsha, China).
tissue: Rat myocardial tissues were immunoprecipitated using anti-ubiquitin affinity magnetic beads.
cell_type: Cardiomyocytes (NRVMs) were infected with lentiviruses carrying the Flag-KDM1A plasmid, and cell lysates were immunoprecipitated using anti-Flag affinity magnetic beads.
disease_state: The ubiquitination sites for the KDM1A protein in the immunoprecipitates were analyzed using mass spectrometry.
